svg.aria-label: Since February 2023 I have opened 375 PRs in repos I don't own, and 278 of them were merged. Counting issues and discussions, that is 982 contributions to 240 repos under 156 owners. Most went to winglang/wing (148 PRs, 132 merged), then aws/aws-cdk (71 issues, 7 PRs, 2 merged) and projen/projen (23 issues, 18 PRs, 11 merged). Across its seven GitHub orgs, AWS adds up to 142 contributions in 25 repos. In 2026 so far: 173 contributions to 58 repos, led by aws/aws-cdk (16).
